name: Exec Cluster E04: Risk Unit + Trailing Stop with Activation
description: Tests: risk_unit with ATR-based stop distance, trailing_stop with activation
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC TEST: Risk-Based Sizing + Trailing Stop
# Tests: E04 (risk_unit), E09 (trailing_stop)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === VOLATILITY MEASURE ===
atr_val = atr(period=14)(src.h, src.l, src.c)

# === SIGNAL: Donchian breakout ===
donchian = donchian_channel(window=20)(src.h, src.l)
upper_prior = donchian.donchian_upper >> 1
lower_prior = donchian.donchian_lower >> 1

entry_long = close > upper_prior
entry_short = close < lower_prior

held_long = hold_until()(enter=entry_long, exit=entry_short)
held_short = hold_until()(enter=entry_short, exit=entry_long)

# === EXECUTION ===
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long, short_entry=held_short)

# E04: Risk-based sizing (2% risk, 2x ATR stop)
stop_dist = atr_val * 2
risk_unit(stop_unit=StopUnit.price)(risk_pct=2, stop_distance=stop_dist)

# E09: Trailing stop with activation (starts trailing after 1.5x ATR profit)
trailing_stop()(distance=atr_val * 3, activation=atr_val * 1.5)
